turns.text: Classify this support ticket into exactly one label: billing | bug | account | data. Ticket: 'My card was declined when I tried to pay the bus deposit.' Reply with the label only.

For the desk records, the queue convention: declined payments, duplicate charges, and refunds are billing; transferring a trip to a different teacher's login is account, because ownership is an access question - payment problems that arise during such a transfer are still billing; freezes are bug; stale content is data. Note the convention in one line.
Morning shift at the help desk. The ticket queue is open; the standing rubric applies. Confirm in one line.

Classify this support ticket. The desk notes are not at hand. Ticket: 'While moving our trip to the new teacher's login the card fee was charged twice; please fix the charge.' Reply with the label only.
